name: sicsu-official-docs
distribution: public repository with bundled font binaries; source-standard PDF is not included
font_loading: Private fontconfig for Linux/Work; five font files in assets/fonts/, names, SHA-256, cmap and PDF font face/embedding checked
compliance_note: Five bundled fonts (楷体_GB2312, 方正小标宋简体, 仿宋_GB2312, Times New Roman, 黑体/SimHei) are included in assets/fonts/ and used by the PDF engine. Machine checks and the standard examples pass, but no final compliance claim is made until the required page-by-page human review is complete. Fonts remain subject to their vendors' licences.
font_source: 黑体/SimHei and full Times New Roman from 浙江师范大学外国语学院《常用办公字体（字库）》(2024-11-10) public package; non-commercial use, verify vendor licence before commercial distribution.
source_standard_pdf: not included; references/format-standard.md is the operational source. Place an authorised copy at assets/source-standard-2026.pdf if needed.
